g.text: Pléiades fuselage sensitivity — binary masks at one physical scale

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #334d5c

g.text: Every tile is 24 m × 24 m with a 5 m ruler. Minima must pass the audited area, length and width intervals.

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #5d4b3e

g.text: Whole, documented-boundary and random-cut shells are geometry sensitivities, not fracture or flooding probabilities. Candidate colours are display-only.
